Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

CohortHonestDiD 1.1.0

New restrictions

  • cohort_sensitivity() accepts seven more restrictions, "SDB", "SDM", "RMB", "RMM", "SDRM", "SDRMB", and "SDRMM". They work with the Conditional and C-LF procedures, and with cohort and aggregate inference. C-LF is the default. The FLCI stays available under SD only.
  • The new argument direction sets the sign ("positive" or "negative") or the monotonicity ("increasing" or "decreasing") for every cohort. The sign is measured from relative period 0 for every estimator.
  • full.path = TRUE works under SD, SDB, and SDM. The other six restrictions do not take it.
  • SDRM, SDRMB, and SDRMM need three pre-treatment coefficients per cohort, counting period 0.
  • print(), summary(), and plot() name the restriction and its direction.

The paper’s simulations do not cover these seven restrictions. The detailed guide has a section on them.

Bug fix

  • control = list(flci.solver = "nested") works with current CVXR. CVXR 1.8 and later no longer export solve(), so the task used to end with status flci_solver_error. The default solver "ECOS" needs the ECOSolveR package, and flci.control = list(solver = "CLARABEL") works without it.

Other changes

  • Results that ran under 1.0.0 are unchanged.
  • restriction = "S" and restriction = "R" no longer work as abbreviations, because they are now ambiguous. Write "SD" or "RM".

CohortHonestDiD 1.0.0

First public release. It estimates cohort-period effects with the imputation and Callaway-Sant’Anna estimators, and it applies the SD and RM restrictions under cohort or aggregate inference with the Conditional, C-LF, and FLCI procedures. It also provides the CR2 covariance, balanced targets and balanced aggregation, and flci_weights().
